title: Card - Highlight Dark
description: Fixed-dark card shell shared by the Blog Hero's featured-article tile and the Writing CTA's decorative code-snippet card, reusing the same on-dark-card surface pairing as Card - CTA Inline. Radius matches Card - Post (the other new card family added for the Blog archive) so all these cards read as one consistent shape language. Border uses border.on-dark (constant across the light/dark toggle) rather than border.card, which flips and would go low-contrast against this always-dark card in light mode. The featured-article-only rainbow top border and hover state live in src/scss/structural/blog-hero.scss, scoped to .ls-blog-hero, since this shell is also reused by a non-interactive card that shouldn't inherit either.
